[issue by goody420]
### Description

im currently playing in a survival world and built a cow farm with conveyor leading the baby`s to crushing wheels that are placed directly above where they stand. when they grow to full size the cow should be getting crushed but it does not? however when i tried testing this in a creative world, exact same set up and it worked fine.  once the cow grew fullsize the crushing wheel ia supposed to deal damage to it.

Are your crushing wheels spinning the right way?

[comment by goody420 (none)]
Yes i had them spinning the correct way, I figured out the issue, for some
reason when I was forceloading the chunk through xaero chunk loader it was
protecting the entities, so I turned off the chunk loading and reloaded it
through FTB chunks and it works totally fine now, I think it had something
to do with it being in a claimed area and not wilderness
